title: Brex footer
description: A near-black footer: wordmark and four link columns (a five-column grid on desktop, 2×2 on phones) with white 14px headings and grey 16px links, a row of social icons beside two store pills, then long 12px legal text with a hanging footnote marker.
notes: forces the theme's dark colours with the dark class, so it stays dark in a light theme
social icons are nodes you pass in
store badges become outlined text pills
name: brex-footer

props.name: brand
props.type: { name: string; href: string; icon?: ReactNode; }
props.description: the wordmark: a name with an optional small icon before it

props.name: social
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon: ReactNode; }[]
props.description: social links: an icon node plus the accessible name

props.name: footnotes
props.description: the dagger footnote paragraphs (the first gets the marker)

props.name: footnoteMarker
props.description: the marker for the footnotes, e.g. a dagger
